title: Latin American steel industry is losing market share due to an influx of imports – OECD
dek: The OECD says Latin America's steel industry is losing market share to an influx of imports, according to GMK Center.
summary: Latin American steelmakers are losing market share because of rising imports, according to the OECD as reported in a GMK Center headline. The publisher's excerpt does not give figures or identify the import sources.
whyItMatters: Import pressure in Latin America is part of the wider effect of global overcapacity, which has pushed several regions towards trade defence measures.
implications: Exporters to Latin America may face a higher risk of anti-dumping or safeguard action, while regional producers may press for protection.
